Disasters struck Mexico as rescuers searched for missing people in flooded towns (BBC World). In AI, OpenAI partnered with Broadcom to produce its own chips (The Verge), and Palmer Luckey's Anduril launched a military helmet with Facebook founder Mark Zuckerberg's assistance (The Verge).
